authorityBoundary: Workspace pricing/adoption fixture only; publisher payload has no price or Order Set authority.

pricingPolicy.collisionPolicy: same masterKey updates only after semantic fingerprint equality; mismatch aborts before write
pricingPolicy.updatePolicy: workspace price may be updated by workspace policy; master identity and publisher payload remain unchanged
pricingPolicy.deletePolicy: never delete existing custom workspace rows; retain and report collisions
pricingPolicy.orderSetPolicy: no Order Set authoring in this Phase A slice

adoptionPolicy.classificationPathBoundary: Use only current five paths plus the eight listed v3 paths; held route is support-only and never a published path.
